bill.title: Jocelyn Nungaray National Wildlife Refuge Act
subjects: Wilderness and natural areas, wildlife refuges, wild rivers, habitats
bill.officialSummary: Jocelyn Nungaray National Wildlife Refuge Act This act renames the Anahuac National Wildlife Refuge located in Anahuac, Texas, as the Jocelyn Nungaray National Wildlife Refuge. The act provides statutory authority for Executive Order 14229 , which also renamed the refuge as the Jocelyn Nungaray National Wildlife Refuge.

plain.whatItDoes: This measure would rename the Anahuac National Wildlife Refuge located in Anahuac, Texas, as the Jocelyn Nungaray National Wildlife Refuge.
plain.whoItTouches: People who use public land, and people who live beside it.
plain.everydayEffect: If it passed, the change would show up in what may be done on that land. Nothing has changed yet. Most bills never become law.
plain.source: Reworded from the official summary. Staff at the Congressional Research Service wrote that summary. It is public domain, and the full text of it is further down this page.
